BEGIN
ALTER TABLE "posts" ADD CONSTRAINT "posts_author_id_users_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("author_id") REFERENCES "users"("id");
COMMIT
insert into "users" ("id", "name", "bio", "active") values ($1, $2, $3, $4), ($5, $6, $7, $8)
insert into "posts" ("id", "author_id", "title") values ($1, $2, $3), ($4, $5, $6), ($7, $8, $9)
select jsonb_build_object($1::text, "users"."id", $2::text, "users"."name", $3::text, "users"."bio", $4::text, "users"."active") from "users" order by "users"."id"

select "posts"."id", "posts"."title", length("posts"."title"), jsonb_build_object($1::text, "users"."id", $2::text, "users"."name", $3::text, "users"."bio", $4::text, "users"."active") from "posts" inner join "users" on "posts"."author_id" = "users"."id" order by "posts"."id"
